# Quicken

> Quicken is a comprehensive personal and business finance management platform offering budgeting, investment tracking, tax preparation, and financial planning tools.

Quicken provides multiple product lines including Quicken Simplifi (cloud-based budgeting and investing), Quicken Business & Personal (all-in-one for self-employed owners), and Quicken Classic (desktop editions). The platform integrates account aggregation, automated expense tracking, retirement planning, and tax reporting across personal and business finances.

## Key Topics

- Quicken Simplifi

## Products & Pricing

- [Quicken: One place to manage your money and your life](https://www.quicken.com): Quicken homepage showcasing personal finance, budgeting, investments, and business solutions.
- [Quicken Simplifi App: Reach money goals the smart & easy way](https://www.quicken.com/products/simplifi): Quicken Simplifi product overview: budgeting, spending tracking, investments, and retirement.
- [Quicken Business & Personal: all-in-one app](https://www.quicken.com/products/business-personal): Quicken Business & Personal product for self-employed owners managing finances and taxes.
- [Plans & Pricing - Quicken Simplifi & LifeHub](https://www.quicken.com/products/pricing-comparison-products): Quicken pricing plans comparison for Simplifi, Business & Personal, and LifeHub products.
- [Plans & Pricing - Quicken Classic](https://www.quicken.com/products/pricing-comparison-classic): Quicken Classic pricing plans: Premier, Deluxe, Business & Personal desktop editions.

## Personal Finance Features

- [Manage your budget](https://www.quicken.com/features/manage-your-budget): Quicken Simplifi Spending Plan feature for budget management and savings goals.
- [Save more money](https://www.quicken.com/features/save-more-money): Quicken Simplifi Savings Goals feature for tracking and achieving financial milestones.
- [Optimize your investments](https://www.quicken.com/features/optimize-your-investments): Quicken investment dashboard for portfolio tracking, retirement savings, and tax planning.
- [Plan for retirement](https://www.quicken.com/features/plan-for-retirement): Quicken Simplifi Retirement Planner for projecting savings and scenario modeling.
- [Get insights with reports](https://www.quicken.com/features/get-insights-with-reports): Quicken financial reports feature for spending, income, savings, and tax preparation.
- [Projected Cashflow](https://www.quicken.com/features/projected-cashflow): Quicken Simplifi Projected Cash Flow feature for financial forecasting up to one year.
- [Aggregation](https://www.quicken.com/features/aggregation): Quicken account aggregation feature for multi-account tracking and financial data security.

## Business Finance Features

- [Business & personal finances, all in one place](https://www.quicken.com/features/why-business-and-Personal): Quicken Business & Personal all-in-one platform for small business and personal finances.
- [Track expenses](https://www.quicken.com/features/track-expenses): Quicken Business & Personal expense tracking with automatic categorization.
- [Invoicing - Get paid faster](https://www.quicken.com/features/invoicing-get-paid-faster): Quicken Business & Personal invoicing feature with Stripe and Apple Pay integration.
- [Manage your cash flow](https://www.quicken.com/features/manage-your-cash-flow): Quicken Business & Personal cash flow management and projection feature.
- [Get insights into your business](https://www.quicken.com/features/get-insights-into-your-business): Quicken Business & Personal reporting for profit & loss, investments, and taxes.
- [Track business taxes](https://www.quicken.com/features/track-business-taxes): Quicken Business & Personal tax tracking with automated categorization and schedules.
